scope: Open media from File Manager, sort with easy keys, and choose booking staff.

topics.title: File Manager keys
details: Control+E opens name search from any File Manager control. Alt+N sorts by name. Alt+C sorts by date created, Alt+M by date modified, and Alt+D by date added. Alt+A uses ascending order. Alt+Z uses descending order. The earlier sort keys still work.

topics.title: One play and pause key
details: Control+P pauses or resumes the current audio from any app screen. It works for local media, radio and podcasts. Control+Shift+P now opens saved stations or podcast subscriptions.

topics.title: Update controls
details: During a download, Tab and Shift+Tab move through Status and Cancel update. Each button speaks its name. Enter activates it. Alt+S or F5 reads status. Alt+C or Escape cancels the download.

topics.title: Open media files
details: Open an MP3 or other media file from File Manager to play it. The app now sends it to the player. It no longer tries to read it as a document. This works after you type the first letters. It also works when you go back to drives and open a folder again.

topics.title: Choose booking staff
details: The Book Services page at Full Circle AT now exposes its staff menu choices. A visible menu inside a hidden page layer can now be read and used. Opening a menu no longer reports a missing name as if you had tried to book. The live staff choice was checked in WebView2. No booking was sent.
